Scene/backdrop: safe terrace facing the distant council crown at night in Caelune, an original city of pearl-stone crescent districts suspended above a deep blue cloud sea by living luminous roads.

Composition/framing: top-to-bottom chronology; one dominant focal subject and no more than two competing actions per frame; simple low-detail backgrounds except when the frame establishes geography; large readable gestures and silhouettes; naturally quiet open areas, but never draw a box for text.
Chronological frames:
Frame 1: Establish safe terrace facing the distant council crown at night with sola, tarin, kesin, serac, fictional_adult_residents; make current geography and emotional condition immediately legible.
Frame 2: Concrete objective: Confirm everyone is accounted for and understand Serac's response; show an adult initiating a specific next step.
